# LaptopWork: Work From Home, Small Business & Professional Development

This llms.txt file is designed to help LLMs better understand and index this website. LaptopWork provides information and practical advice related to working from home, small business, freelancing, professional development, and maintaining productivity while working remotely.

## Sitemaps

https://laptopwork.com/sitemap_index.xml: Includes the website's crawlable and indexable content.
